environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no managed rule groups). The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic on port 443 to the target group. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The container runs with the default task role (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/ecs-task-default) which has no restrictions on the application's own database operations. No request inspection or filtering is applied at any layer.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default forwarding rule, no WAF association
config.database: SQLite on ephemeral storage, initialized at startup
